title: Account Assistant
description:
As an Account Assistant in Southampton within the leisure, travel and tourism industry, you'll play a key role in supporting the accounting and finance team with day-to-day tasks. Your work will help ensure financial processes run smoothly and accurately, contributing to the overall efficiency of the business.

Client Details

A company based in Southampton operating in the leisure, travel and tourism industry.

Description
- Process invoices and manage accounts payable and receivable activities.
- Assist with reconciliations and ensure accuracy in financial records.
- Support the preparation of financial reports and statements.
- Maintain and update financial data in the accounting system.
- Handle queries related to financial transactions and accounts.
- Collaborate with the finance team to meet deadlines and objectives.
- Assist with month-end and year-end financial tasks.
- Ensure compliance with internal accounting policies and procedures.

Profile

A successful Account Assistant should have:
- Previous experience in an accounting or finance role.
- A good understanding of financial processes and systems.
- Strong numerical and analytical skills.
- Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Excel.
- Attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
- Good organisational skills to manage tasks effectively.
- Ability to work collaboratively within a team environment.

Job Offer
- A salary ranging from £30,000 to £35,000, dependent on the level of experience.
- A permanent position in the leisure, travel and tourism industry.
- Opportunities to develop your skills within a professional accounting and finance team.

title: Credit Controller
description:
As a Credit Controller in Southampton, you'll play a key role in managing the accounts receivable process for the retail industry. Your work will help ensure the smooth running of the company's finances by maintaining healthy cash flow and reducing outstanding debts.

Client Details

A company in the retail industry based in Southampton.

Description
- Manage customer accounts and monitor outstanding balances.
- Chase overdue payments via phone, email, or written correspondence.
- Reconcile customer accounts and resolve discrepancies promptly.
- Prepare and distribute account statements and reports.
- Maintain accurate records of all credit control activities.
- Liaise with internal teams to resolve invoice queries.
- Assist with setting and monitoring credit limits for customers.
- Support month-end reporting and compliance processes.

Profile

A successful Credit Controller should have:
- Experience in credit control or a similar accounting role.
- Knowledge of financial processes and procedures.
- Strong attention to detail and organisational skills.
- Confidence in communicating with customers and internal teams.
- Proficiency in using financial software and Excel.
- A proactive approach to problem-solving and debt management.

Job Offer
- Salary of £30,000 to £35,000, dependent on the level of experience.
- Permanent position with opportunities to develop skills in the retail industry.
- Located in Southampton for ease of access.

title: Import Coordinator
description:
Ocean Imports Operator
- Location: Southampton Area
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Are you an experienced freight forwarding professional looking for a varied role where you can manage shipments from start to finish and build strong customer relationships? A well-established international logistics business is seeking an Ocean Imports Operator to join its growing operations team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with ocean freight import experience who enjoys taking ownership of shipments and delivering a high level of customer service.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Managing FCL and LCL ocean import shipments from start to finish.
- Processing and checking shipping documentation.
- Ensuring compliance with customs and import procedures.
- Preparing and completing customs declarations.
- Providing shipment updates to customers via phone and email.
- Arranging deliveries with hauliers and service providers.
- Producing customer invoices and checking supplier invoices.
- Providing proof of delivery documentation.
- Preparing quotations and arranging bookings for new shipments.
- Maintaining excellent customer relationships and service levels.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Previous experience within freight forwarding, specifically ocean imports.
- Experience managing customer accounts and import shipments independently.
- Strong understanding of import documentation and customs processes.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- High attention to detail and strong organisational abilities.
- A proactive and customer-focused approach.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary.
- Monday to Friday working hours.
- Overtime opportunities paid at enhanced rates.
- Annual bonus scheme after successful probation.
- Increasing holiday entitlement with length of service.
- Employee Assistance Programme.
- Supportive team environment with opportunities for long-term development.

If you're looking to join a respected logistics business where you can make an impact and further develop your freight forwarding career, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today or get in touch for a confidential discussion. Please submit your CV and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and why you are interested in this Ocean Imports Operator position.

title: Shipping Coordinator
company: Elliot Marsh Head Hunting Partners - Agency - Permanent
description:
Are you ready to manage shipments and build strong customer relationships? A leading logistics company has an exciting Shipping Coordinator opportunity!

Location: Southampton

Salary: Up to £30,000 per annum

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Hours: 09:00 - 17:30 Monday to Friday

About Us:

We are a well-established freight forwarding company specialising in logistics, e-commerce and warehousing. We manage freight from around the world by road and rail, through the air and across the oceans. With a reputation as a supportive, people-focused employer, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service across our growing operation.

Shipping Coordinator - The Role:

You will join our fast-growing Road Freight or Ocean Freight export departments, working closely with customers to manage all aspects of their exports. This varied role involves issuing quotes, arranging shipments, managing customs clearance processes and ensuring customers receive their shipments on time. You will build close working relationships with customers, overseas partners and internal teams, making excellent communication skills essential. Continuous support and training will help you develop your knowledge and grow your career with us.

Shipping Coordinator - Key Responsibilities:
- Issue quotes and arrange shipments for road and ocean freight customers
- Manage the customs clearance process from start to finish
- Coordinate with customers, overseas partners and internal teams to ensure timely delivery
- Monitor shipments and resolve any issues that arise
- Build and maintain strong customer relationships through effective communication

Shipping Coordinator - You:
- Experience working in a customer service environment, either face to face or over the phone
- Prior experience in Road Freight, Ocean Freight and/or Exports with hands-on shipment management or coordination
- Excellent attention to detail and problem solving skills
- Strong computer skills and ability to work in a fast-paced office environment
- Right to work in the UK (we are not able to sponsor work permits)

Benefits:
- Generous holiday allowance
- Life cover and healthcare benefits
- Pension scheme and profit related pay
- On-site parking
- Employee discounts and perks
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Training and upskilling opportunities

To submit your CV for this exciting Shipping Coordinator opportunity, click Apply today!

title: Personal Assistant

title: Administration Assistant
company: Hampshire and Isle of Wight Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust
advertiser_name: Hampshire and Isle of Wight Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust
description: We are looking for a motivated and organised Administrator to join our busy inpatient wards and play a key role in supporting safe, efficient and compassionate patient care. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working in a fast paced clinical environment, being part of a supportive team, and making a real difference every day. As an essential member of the ward team, you will manage day today administrative tasks, support admissions and discharges, maintain accurate records, coordinate communication across clinical staff, and ensure smooth running of ward processes. You will be the first point of contact for patients, families and professionals, helping us deliver a positive and responsive experience. This role is ideal for someone who is proactive, confident using IT systems, and able to prioritise effectively. You will work closely with nurses, doctors, therapists and ward clerks, contributing to high quality care and supporting the wider multidisciplinary team. We offer a friendly and inclusive working environment, opportunities to develop your skills, and the chance to be part of a service that values teamwork, compassion and excellence. Only open to applicants from Hampshire & Isle of Wight NHS system, which is limited to: Hampshire and Isle of Wight ICB, Hampshire & Isle of Wight Healthcare FT, Portsmouth Hospitals University NHS Trust, University Hospital Southampton FT, South Central Ambulance Service, Isle of Wight NHS FT or Hampshire Hospitals FT. The postholder will provide comprehensive administrative support to the inpatient wards, ensuring all essential processes are completed accurately and on time. This includes managing patient information, updating electronic systems, preparing documentation, and supporting the coordination of admissions, transfers and discharges. You will support meetings by preparing agendas, taking accurate minutes and circulating actions to the relevant staff. This will include MDT discussions, wardbased meetings and operational updates. Maintaining clear records and ensuring followup actions are completed is a key part of the role. You will handle enquiries from patients, families, staff and external professionals, ensuring messages are recorded and passed on promptly. The role also involves maintaining ward records, assisting with recruitment paperwork and ensuring all administrative tasks meet Trust standards. You will work closely with ward clerks, the wider admin team, matrons and ward managers to support effective communication and smooth ward operations. The postholder will contribute to maintaining safe patient flow, timely documentation and efficient daytoday functioning of the wards. The successful candidate will need strong organisational skills, accuracy in data entry and confidence using IT systems. Professionalism, reliability and a proactive approach are essential.
